title: EVT:SYSTEM_STRESS_STATE_UPDATED payload schema
description: Emitted by SystemStressOverlay when the composite stress state changes for a symbol. Only emitted on state transitions (not every bar). Phase 0.5 integration point.

state.description: New stress state after the transition

stress_level.description: Composite stress level [0.0, 1.0] that triggered the transition

bars_in_state.description: Number of bars spent in the new state (reset on each transition)

circuit_broken.description: True if circuit breaker is active (max_switches_per_window exceeded)

bars_seen.description: Total bars processed for this symbol (includes burn-in)

z_mad_atr.description: Robust MAD ATR z-score at transition

z_mad_vol.description: Robust MAD realized volatility z-score at transition

z_mad_gap.description: Robust MAD price gap z-score at transition

z_mad_range.description: Robust MAD bar range z-score at transition
